summary: Verge beside bushland and golf course; cars park here, homes across the road.
reasons: Backs onto bush and golf course
Cars park on verge and opposite kerb

best_section.where: Harts Road south side, along the bushy verge west of the corner house

drivers.seclusion: South side is bush and golf course; nearest houses are across the road, 40 m or more from this section.
drivers.access_and_room: Dirt verge beside the lane with a car already pulled onto it in the QLD image.
drivers.traffic: Residential road with moderate traffic; the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Cars park on both kerbs here, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Steep: about 6% grade, falling to the west
Houses 20-22 m across the road at 26 m and 83 m, outside the best section
sun_shade: Tree canopy covers much of the verge, mainly from the south; open to the north sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the verge ground is firm
